<style>
        
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0B0F19;
            --bg-secondary: #161B26;
            --bg-card: #161B26;
            --blue: #3B82F6;
            --green: #10B981;
            --gold: #F59E0B;
            --text-heading: #F3F4F6;
            --text-body: #9CA3AF;
            --text-muted: #6B7280;
            --border-color: #1F2937;
            --shadow-glow: 0 0 30px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);
        }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-body);
            line-height: 1.7;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-primary); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--blue); border-radius: 10px; }
        a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
        .container {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 2rem;
        }
        .text-center { text-align: center; }
        .mt-2 { margin-top: 2rem; }
        .mb-2 { margin-bottom: 2rem; }
        .mt-3 { margin-top: 3rem; }

        
        .top-bar {
            background: #080C15;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 0.5rem 0;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .top-bar .container {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }
        .top-bar .badge {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            padding: 0.15rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 40px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-body);
        }
        .top-bar .badge i { color: var(--blue); margin-right: 0.2rem; }
        .top-bar .ntn { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }

        
        .navbar {
            background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.92);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 0.6rem 0;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
        }
        .navbar .container {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }
        .navbar .logo {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #fff;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }
        .navbar .logo span { color: var(--blue); }
        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 0.2rem;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .nav-links a, .nav-links .nav-btn {
            padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-body);
            transition: 0.25s;
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
            background: transparent;
            font-family: inherit;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links .nav-btn:hover,
        .nav-links a.active, .nav-links .nav-btn.active {
            background: var(--blue);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
        }
        .nav-links .external-link { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
        .nav-links .external-link:hover { border-color: var(--blue); background: transparent; color: var(--blue); }
        .nav-links .highlight-link {
            background: var(--blue);
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .nav-links .highlight-link:hover { background: #2563EB; color: #fff; }

        
        .page { display: none; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease; }
        .page.active-page { display: block; }
        @keyframes fadeUp {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        
        .section { padding: 4rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
        .section:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; }
        .section-title {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -1px;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            color: var(--text-heading);
        }
        .section-title .highlight { color: var(--blue); }
        .section-sub {
            color: var(--text-body);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        
        .card-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
        }
        .card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 1.5rem;
            padding: 2rem;
            transition: 0.3s;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }
        .card:hover {
            border-color: var(--blue);
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .card .icon { font-size: 2.5rem; color: var(--blue); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
        .card h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-heading); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
        .card p { color: var(--text-body); font-size: 0.95rem; }
        .card .link-group {
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding-top: 1.2rem;
        }
        .card .link-group .label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); display: block; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
        .card .link-group a {
            display: block;
            color: var(--text-body);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            padding: 0.1rem 0;
            transition: 0.2s;
            word-break: break-all;
        }
        .card .link-group a:hover { color: var(--blue); text-decoration: underline; }
        
        
        .btn-primary {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--blue);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 0.6rem 1.8rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: 0.3s;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover { background: #2563EB; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59,130,246,0.4); transform: scale(1.03); }
        .btn-green {
            background: var(--green);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 0.8rem 2.5rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: 0.3s;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-block;
        }
        .btn-green:hover { background: #059669; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(16,185,129,0.4); transform: scale(1.05); }
        .btn-outline {
            display: inline-block;
            border: 1px solid var(--blue);
            color: var(--blue);
            padding: 0.6rem 1.8rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }
        .btn-team {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--gold);
            color: #0B0F19;
            padding: 0.7rem 2rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-weight: 800;
            transition: 0.3s;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .btn-team:hover { background: #D97706; transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); }

        
        .profile-hero { padding: 3rem 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, #0f1a2e, var(--bg-primary)); }
        .profile-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 2rem;
            padding: 2.5rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 2.5rem;
            align-items: center;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .profile-card .avatar {
            width: 150px;
            height: 150px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 3px solid var(--blue);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image: url('avatar.png');
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .profile-card .info { flex: 1; }
        .profile-card .info h2 { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--text-heading); letter-spacing: -1px; }
        .profile-card .info .title { color: var(--blue); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-top: 0.2rem; }
        .profile-card .info .bio { color: var(--text-body); max-width: 600px; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.95rem; }
        .profile-card .info .contact { margin-top: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.8rem; }
        .profile-card .info .contact a {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-body);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: 0.2s;
        }
        .profile-card .info .contact a:hover { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; border-color: var(--blue); }
        .profile-skills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.8rem; justify-content: center; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
        .profile-skills span {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            padding: 0.2rem 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-body);
        }
        .profile-skills span i { color: var(--blue); margin-right: 0.3rem; }

        
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 2rem 0;
        }
        .stats-grid .num { font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--blue); line-height: 1; }
        .stats-grid .label { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; }
        .stats-grid .trend { color: var(--green); font-size: 0.8rem; }

        
        .master-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0B132B, #1A0B2E);
            border: 1px solid var(--green);
            border-radius: 2rem;
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            margin: 2rem 0;
            box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
        }
        .master-banner h2 { font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; }
        .master-banner .highlight-green { color: var(--green); }
        .master-banner p { color: var(--text-body); max-width: 700px; margin: 0.5rem auto 1.5rem; }

        
        .timeline-container { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; padding-left: 2rem; }
        .timeline-container::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 6px;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: var(--blue);
            opacity: 0.4;
        }
        .milestone {
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            padding-left: 2rem;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
            border-radius: 1rem;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .milestone:hover { border-color: var(--green); transform: translateX(6px); }
        .milestone .year { color: var(--blue); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 1px; }
        .milestone h3 { color: var(--text-heading); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; }
        .milestone p { color: var(--text-body); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; }

        
        .testimonial-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
        }
        .testimonial {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 1.5rem;
            padding: 2rem;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .testimonial:hover { border-color: var(--blue); }
        .testimonial .quote { font-style: italic; color: var(--text-body); }
        .testimonial .author { margin-top: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-heading); }
        .testimonial .author span { font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }

        
        .tech-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .tech-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 2rem;
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            transition: 0.3s;
            min-width: 100px;
        }
        .tech-item:hover { border-color: var(--blue); transform: translateY(-4px); }
        .tech-item i { font-size: 2.2rem; color: var(--blue); display: block; }
        .tech-item .name { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-body); margin-top: 0.3rem; }

        
        .footer {
            background: #080C15;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 3rem 0 1.5rem;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }
        .footer .container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
        }
        .footer h4 { color: var(--text-heading); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
        .footer a {
            display: block;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            padding: 0.2rem 0;
            transition: 0.2s;
        }
        .footer a:hover { color: var(--blue); }
        .footer .copy {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding-top: 1.5rem;
            margin-top: 1rem;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .footer .copy strong { color: var(--text-heading); }

        
        .scroll-top {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 2rem;
            right: 2rem;
            background: var(--blue);
            color: #fff;
            width: 45px;
            height: 45px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: none;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59,130,246,0.3);
            transition: 0.3s;
            z-index: 999;
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transform: translateY(20px);
        }
        .scroll-top.visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
        .scroll-top:hover { background: var(--green); transform: scale(1.1); }

        
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container { padding: 0 1rem; }
            .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
            .navbar .logo { font-size: 1.2rem; }
            .nav-links a, .nav-links .nav-btn { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; }
            .section-title { font-size: 2rem; }
            .profile-card .avatar { width: 100px; height: 100px; }
            .profile-card { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
            .profile-card .info .contact { justify-content: center; }
            .master-banner { padding: 2rem 1rem; }
            .master-banner h2 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
            .footer .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .footer .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
    </style>
js: (function() { const pages = { cv: document.getElementById('page-cv'), home: document.getElementById('page-home'), journey: document.getElementById('page-journey') }; const navBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn[data-page]'); window.showPage = function(pageId) { Object.values(pages).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active-page')); if (pages[pageId]) pages[pageId].classList.add('active-page'); navBtns.forEach(btn => { btn.classList.remove('active'); if (btn.dataset.page === pageId) btn.classList.add('active'); }); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }; navBtns.forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); const pageId = this.dataset.page; if (pageId && pages[pageId]) showPage(pageId); }); }); let hasActive = false; Object.keys(pages).forEach(key => { if (pages[key].classList.contains('active-page')) hasActive = true; }); if (!hasActive) showPage('cv'); const scrollBtn = document.getElementById('scrollTopBtn'); window.addEventListener('scroll', function() { if (window.scrollY > 400) scrollBtn.classList.add('visible'); else scrollBtn.classList.remove('visible'); }); scrollBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }); })();
